attack_chain: Multiple users submit comments concurrently via POST /comment (app.py:11-14)
The global COMMENTS list (app.py:8) is modified in-place without thread-safety mechanisms (Flask is multi-threaded by default)
A TOCTOU (Time-of-Check-Time-of-Use) race occurs: two threads read the list, append, and write back, causing one comment to overwrite another
Result: Lost or corrupted comments in the COMMENTS list

The list.append() operation is not atomic, leading to lost or interleaved comment data
